accounting: slack_Q = slack_Lap - 2 dH_Lap - d resid,  d resid = resid(5) - resid(4) (exact identity)
failure_rules: data gate failure -> stop before any fit
NaN restart request (RetryDetected) -> stop the run (frozen EMC rule)
Laplace not OK -> C_Lap INCOMPLETE for that dataset and d; no imputation
paired comparisons across d use only replicates complete at the compared d
no retry, no reseed, no tolerance change, no resume
frozen_before: any d=30/60 fit; written by --gates and re-verified by --full

H1.statement: median over replicates of C_Q slack_45 increases with d

H2.H2c_refute: at some d, median |d resid| > median |2 dH_Lap|
H2.note: positivity at d=60 is a prediction from oracle curvature, not a theorem
H2.statement: 2 dH_Lap(4->5) decreases with d, stays positive at d=60 (C_Q remains stricter than C_Lap), and accounts for the C_Lap - C_Q slack difference

H3.refute: fixed-penalty median slack at d=60 <= at d=15
H3.statement: with P_theta held at its d=15 count (diagnostic selector, not a criterion) the C_Q slack_45 increases with d
H3.support: fixed-penalty median slack m15 < m30 < m60

hypotheses.not_predicted: exact counts of the real (penalised) criteria; C_Lap direction
hypotheses.scope: Gaussian-X thresholds (2.84, 2*pi*e) are NOT used as predictions for this Poisson-X / Bernoulli-Y model

mechanism: X Fisher at truth and at (theta_hat, Z_hat)
ln|H| = ln|P_X+prior| + ln|I + P^-1 H_Y| (exact split)
primary: exact counts per d and criterion
C_Q: fit gain D_K(4)-D_K(5), dP_Z, dP_theta
C_Lap: fit_mode gain, d volume, dP_theta
number of datasets where C_Q and C_Lap select different K
replication_role: reproducibility check only; never counted as data
selection: mean of the criterion over the 2 starts, argmin; C_Lap INCOMPLETE if any fit not OK
target: K* = 5 (minimal representation dimension; derivation for canonical Poisson-X with rank F = K, unconditional law; NOT K0 uniqueness). Under- and over-selection are both errors relative to K*.
